<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="cmn_relative_duration"><cmn_relative_duration action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><name>Ransomware Payment Made Duration</name><script><![CDATA[// Perform relative duration calculation using the 'calculator' variable (which is a DurationCalculator object)

(function() {
    var paymentTime;

    // Work out if "current" is a Task record or Task SLA and then get the "payment_date_time" element from the Task
    var tableName = current.getTableName();
    if (tableName) {
        var baseTableName = GlideDBObjectManager.getAbsoluteBase(tableName);
        if (baseTableName == "task")
             paymentTime = current.getElement("parent_cyber_incident.payment_date_time");
        else if (baseTableName == "task_sla")
            paymentTime = current.getElement("task.parent_cyber_incident.payment_date_time");
    }

    //add application system property for ransomware onto the payment date time
    var ransomwareSLA = Number(gs.getProperty('x_1776078_cyber_0.sla.ransomware_report_hours')) * 3600;
    var notificationDueTime = new GlideDateTime(paymentTime.getGlideObject());
    notificationDueTime.addSeconds(ransomwareSLA);

    // if we've got a "breach date" and it's already breached, set the "breach date" to 1 second in the future
	var slaCreated = new GlideDateTime(calculator.startDateTime);
    if (notificationDueTime.before(slaCreated)) {
        slaCreated.addSeconds(1);
		notificationDueTime = slaCreated;
    }

    // set the endDateTime property of the calculator object
    calculator.endDateTime = notificationDueTime;
    calculator.calcScheduleDuration();
})();]]></script><sys_class_name>cmn_relative_duration</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-11 11:56:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>401b694b836acf1044779cb6feaad3fe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>26</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Ransomware Payment Made Duration</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>cmn_relative_duration_401b694b836acf1044779cb6feaad3fe</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-25 04:25:04</sys_updated_on></cmn_relative_duration></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident">impactVALCHANGES^ORaffected_asset_typeVALCHANGES^ORdata_classification_of_affected_assetsVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="impact" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="affected_asset_type" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="true" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="data_classification_of_affected_assets" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="true" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Set suggested SOCI classification</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {
    //Get Impact, Affected Asset Type, Data Classification from current
    var myImpact = current.getValue('impact');
    var myAssetType = current.getValue('affected_asset_type');

    //if Impact or Affected Asset Type empty → clear result and return
	if (!myImpact || !myAssetType) {
        current.suggested_soci_classification = '';
        return;
    }
    //Matrix lookup → result = matrix[impact][assetType]
    var matrixAsset = myAssetType.indexOf('regulated') !== -1 ? 'regulated' : 'corporate';
    var reportMatrix = {
        '1': {
            'regulated': 'significant',
            'corporate': 'relevant'
        },
        '2': {
            'regulated': 'significant',
            'corporate': 'relevant'
        },
        '3': {
            'regulated': 'relevant',
            'corporate': 'no_report'
        },
        '4': {
            'regulated': 'no_report',
            'corporate': 'no_report'
        }
    };
    var myResult = reportMatrix[myImpact][matrixAsset];

    //Floor check → if Data Classification contains PI/SOI/CII AND result === 'no_report' → result = 'relevant'
    var myDataClass = current.getValue('data_classification_of_affected_assets');
    if ((myDataClass.indexOf('sensitive_operational') !== -1 ||
            myDataClass.indexOf('private_information') !== -1 ||
            myDataClass.indexOf('critical_infrastructure') !== -1) &&
        myResult === 'no_report') {
        myResult = 'relevant';
    }

    //Set current.suggested_soci_classification = result
    current.suggested_soci_classification = myResult;

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-02 11:46:52</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>05fa974883e2cb1044779cb6feaad36a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set suggested SOCI classification</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_05fa974883e2cb1044779cb6feaad36a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-25 03:04:50</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=05fa974883e2cb1044779cb6feaad36a"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident">stateVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>State transition validation</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    //guard to prevent error when SLA task creation engine runs twice by design. This was triggering state validation on the second pass, but there is no values for previous availble.
    if (!previous.getValue('state')) {
        gs.info('State transition validation skipped - no previous state available.\nCurrent state: ' + current.getValue('state') + ' - previous state: ' + previous.getValue('state') + ' - isNewRecord: ' + current.isNewRecord());
        return;
    }


    //allow save if close code is false positive and any state except eradication
    if (current.getValue('close_code') === 'false_positive' && current.getValue('state') === '3') {
        if (previous.getValue('state') === '13') {
            gs.addErrorMessage('Incidents cannot be closed directly from Eradication - progress to Recovery first.')
            current.setAbortAction(true);
        }
        return;
    }

    //allow save if state transition is valid
    var validStateTransition = {
        '1': ['11'],
        '11': ['12', '15'],
        '12': ['13', '11', '15'],
        '13': ['14', '12', '11'],
        '14': ['3', '13', '12', '11'],
        '15': ['11', '12', '13', '14'],
        '3': []
    };
    if (validStateTransition[previous.getValue('state')].indexOf(current.getValue('state')) !== -1) {
        return;
    } else {
        gs.addErrorMessage('Invalid state transition - changing State from ' + previous.getDisplayValue('state') + ' to ' + current.getDisplayValue('state') + ' is not permitted.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-09 08:57:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>18ec229a83a28b1044779cb6feaad310</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>State transition validation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_18ec229a83a28b1044779cb6feaad310</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-25 04:45:16</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=18ec229a83a28b1044779cb6feaad310"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1776078_cyber_0_regulatory_notification_task</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Create REG Legal approval</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    //query sys_user_grmember for members of the legal group
    var groupMembers = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
    groupMembers.addQuery('group', '2b10a3d5836a831044779cb6feaad307');
    groupMembers.query();

    //while there are more members
    while (groupMembers.next()) {

        //create a new approver record  for each member of legal
        var newApprover = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        newApprover.initialize();
        newApprover.setValue('document_id', current.sys_id);
		newApprover.setValue('sysapproval', current.sys_id);
        newApprover.setValue('source_table', 'x_1776078_cyber_0_regulatory_notification_task');
        newApprover.setValue('approval_reason', current.getValue('notification_type'));
        newApprover.setValue('approver', groupMembers.getValue('user'));
        newApprover.setValue('state', 'requested');
        newApprover.insert();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-06 10:20:47</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>5ce5a31583aa831044779cb6feaad3bd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create REG Legal approval</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_5ce5a31583aa831044779cb6feaad3bd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-25 03:50:11</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=5ce5a31583aa831044779cb6feaad3bd"/></record_update>
